description: Wire contract for a public venue/board correction report. Committed byte-identically in cruxcoach-dashboard (packages/shared/contracts/) and cruxcoach-pages (tools/); a test in each repo pins its SHA-256 so the two cannot drift.
notes: Absence of an access value means unknown. A report may never be read as evidence that a venue is public.
evidenceUrl is attacker-controlled. It is stored and shown to operators as inert text and is never fetched, previewed or auto-applied.
reporter.npub is optional. Anonymous reports are first-class and must not be degraded to make the signed path attractive.
No field of a report is ever published as a public Nostr event, written to a URL, sent to analytics, or persisted in the reporter's browser.
